title: POV: Purane Gaon Ke Kuwe Ke 3 Rules. Teesra Kabhi Mat Todna 😱
description: Raat ko gaon ke purane kuwe ke paas akele mat jaana. Yeh aik farzi aur khaufnak kahani hai.

scenes.subtitle: Kuwe se maa ki awaz aa rahi hai.
scenes.voice: Kuwe se maa ki awaz aa rahi hai۔
scenes.image_prompt: A close up cartoon shot of YOU standing frozen in absolute terror near a dark deep village well at night, staring down into the black water as a pale ghostly hand reaches up from the rim.

scenes.subtitle: Purane buzurgon ne teen sakht rules likhe thay.
scenes.voice: Purane buzurgon ne teen sakht rules likhe thay۔
scenes.image_prompt: A cartoon shot of YOU looking at a yellowed handwritten note on old paper under a dim lantern light, trembling in a dark village street.

scenes.subtitle: Pehla rule: kuwe ke paas raat ko mat jaana.
scenes.voice: پہلا رول: kuwe ke paas raat ko mat jaana۔
scenes.label: RULE 1
scenes.image_prompt: A cartoon shot of YOU standing far away from a spooky old stone well in a lonely village courtyard at midnight, holding a lantern and looking nervous.

scenes.subtitle: Doosra rule: pani mein kabhi apna chehra mat dekhna.
scenes.voice: دوسرا رول: pani mein kabhi apna chehra mat dekhna۔
scenes.label: RULE 2
scenes.image_prompt: A cartoon shot of YOU standing near the well edge, deliberately keeping your head turned away from the dark water below to avoid looking down.

scenes.subtitle: Teesra rule: apnon ki awaz sun kar peechhe mat mudna.
scenes.voice: تیسرا رول: apnon ki awaz sun kar peechhe mat mudna۔
scenes.label: RULE 3
scenes.image_prompt: A cartoon shot of YOU standing straight with your back to the camera, hands shaking, ignoring a soft ghostly voice calling your name from the dark.

scenes.subtitle: Aapne doosra rule tod kar pani mein dekh liya.
scenes.voice: Aapne doosra rule tod kar pani mein dekh liya۔
scenes.image_prompt: A cartoon shot of YOU leaning over the dark well water, staring down in shock as the water reflects a terrifying glowing-eyed face that is not yours.

scenes.subtitle: Aap kya karenge? A, kuwe mein utar jayein, ya B, wahan se bhaag jayein? Comment mein A ya B likhein.
scenes.voice: Aap kya karenge؟ A، kuwe mein utar jayein، ya B، wahan se bhaag jayein؟ Comment mein A ya B likhein۔
scenes.label: A YA B?
